title: Obtaining External IAM IdP Details Using API

blocks.text: This article provides information for obtaining Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) external IAM identity provider (IdP) details using APIs. All APIs are rate limited. To learn more, see Understanding Rate Limiting.
The external IAM IdP is an external IdP attribute configured in Authentication Service and is only supported for IdPs created in Authentication Service.

blocks.heading: Getting Details of All External IAM IdPs

blocks.text: To get details of all external IAM IdPs for a specific customer:

blocks.item: Send a GET request to the following endpoint: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/iamidpmapping.
Provide the customerId, the ZPA tenant ID of the customer, in the request endpoint. For example: /mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/73189906330943488/iamidpmapping.
